messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: residuals for Q3
parts:
You mean something like the following?

library(mirt)
mod <- mirt(Science, 1)
Q3 <- residuals(mod, 'Q3', verbose=FALSE)
Q3

library(corrplot)
corrplot(Q3)

Phil
